response.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT o.observstation, o.weathprofile, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS group_avg_band, COUNT(*) AS group_count FROM telescopes t INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.pointaccarc > 4.86 GROUP BY o.observstation, o.weathprofile) SELECT AVG(group_avg_band) AS avg_of_group_avgs, AVG(group_count) AS avg_of_group_counts FROM grouped;
